notes.title: Happy Halloween! Recent developments in game
notes.content:
Hello guys, it has been some time since the launch of Chill Drive. Recently, while optimizing the program, I have also been thinking about creating new features, such as sharing activities or creating a weekly focused ranking. Do you have any good ideas? Welcome to exchange and discuss~

Finally, Happy Halloween!

notes.title: Welcome to Chill Drive
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am pleased to announce that Chill Drive is comming soon, and the game development has entered the final stage. There is an interesting thing that I also open Chill Drive during programming, which keeps me in a relaxed and undisturbed state. So, I hope this game can also provide a different experience for everyone when they are studying or resting. If you have any suggestions, welcome to send me an email: [noparse]chilldrive@163.com[/noparse]. We can communicate and discuss at any time!

If you like,  join the wishlist, then you can always get the latest news!
